newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DHL to set up Philippine cargo centre.
newsitem.headline: DHL to set up Philippine cargo centre.

text.p: DHL Aviation (Philippines) Inc, a unit of DHL Worldwide Express, has signed a preliminary pact to set up an air cargo handling and distribution centre at the Clark special economic zone, a Clark official said on Wednesday.
Clark Development Corp President Romeo David said in a statement DHL plans to lease a 4,500 square-meter area inside the Clark international aviation complex.
A more binding lease agreement is expected to be signed in January next year, he added.
In the same statement, DHL director for air and hub services, Neil Henderson, said the company will be using six Boeing 727s for their future operations inside Clark.
Clark, about 80 kms (50 miles) north of Manila, was a former U.S. airbase until four years ago. American forces left when the Philippine Senate refused to renew the lease on the base.
DHL's rival Federal Express Corporation has its main Asian hub a few miles from Clark at Subic Bay, which is a former U.S. naval base.
